687-2034-4613-8130-8131.description:
Cast Aven Eternal by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Aven Eternal enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Aven Eternal and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Aven Eternal from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-4613-8130-8131.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

2167-5626-5721-7889.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5721-7889.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

215-1129-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-7175.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1698-3260-3540-7753.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-7753.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-7753.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

3197-6720-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6720-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

193-1124-2724-4006.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Hushbringer.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2105-5434-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2105-5434-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1869-2120-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to block Wanderwine prophets.
1869-2120-4050.description:
Cast Wanderwine Prophets by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets with haste.
The token Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets.
The nontoken Wanderwine Prophets leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Wanderwine Prophets token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Wanderwine Prophets from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until satisfied.
When the nontoken wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, it triggers Inalla and Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve Inalla's trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, championing original Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve the Wanderwine Prophets trigger, does nothing.
Move to combat.
Declare token copy of Wanderwine Prophets as attacker.
Deal combat damage with Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice itself and take an extra turn after this one.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets leaves the battlefield, returning Wanderwine Prophets to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat step 2 to 5.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 14.

186-539-4552-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures excluding Magus of the Candelabra that do not have summoning sickness.
186-539-4552-4657.description:
Activate two creatures other than Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} due to Heartstone and Blossoming Tortoise and tapping it, untapping it and the two other creatures.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4508-5880-7223.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2

1399-1606-2404-7223.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
1399-1606-2404-7223.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3480-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1606-3263-6871.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

457-2043-4826-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six multicolored permanents.
457-2043-4826-6741.description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating an untapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control due to Archelos.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer six times by tapping six Robots, adding six {U}.
Repeat.
457-2043-4826-6741.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

147-413-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-413-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1170-1329-1492-3499.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-3499.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-6798-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-6798-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

3532-3581-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-3581-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

454-1978-3990.description:
Cause Incubation Druid to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type a land you control can produce
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2034-5220-5631-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-5631-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2034-2308-3845.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-3845.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1849-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4053-5147--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5147--73.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

851-4067-5742-5743.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

428-1694-2736-4493.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication.
428-1694-2736-4493.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

372-864-4598.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-864-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

749-1558-1908-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five nontoken creatures.
749-1558-1908-3263.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Lena with haste.
Put the Lena token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lena token enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Lena token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

774-2137-2748.notablePrerequisites:
A player controls an indestructible artifact.
You control at least two lands.
774-2137-2748.description:
Cast Deconstruct by paying {2}{G}, targeting the indestructible artifact.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand, copying Deconstruct, targeting the indestructible artifact.
Resolve the copy of Deconstruct, failing to destroy the artifact and adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-4241-4499.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.

562-4944.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor's ability.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

262-567-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-567-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Soul's Attendant three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

1337-1636.notablePrerequisites: Tolsimir does not have summoning sickness.
1337-1636.description:
Activate Tolsmir Wolfblood by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Voja legendary creature token.
If you control two or more Voja tokens, put one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Voja token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1987-3075-4125-4792.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-4125-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.

3459-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
3459-4702.description:
Tap Battered Golem, making a token copy of itself.
When the token ETBs, each other Battered Golem triggers, untapping them.
Repeat for infinite Battered Golem tokens with haste.

406-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Tandem Lookout is paired with Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
406-4869.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
After all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.
